title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 37
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 37: the valley of dry bones that came to life, and the two sticks joined into one.

questions.text: What was the valley full of, when the prophet was set down in the middle of it?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's hand was on him, and he was set down in the middle of the valley, and it was full of bones.

questions.text: What does the text say about the condition of the bones in the open valley?
questions.explanation: There were very many bones in the open valley, and they were very dry.

questions.text: How did the prophet answer the question "Son of man, can these bones live?"
What happened while he prophesied over the bones?
questions.explanation: As he prophesied there was a noise and an earthquake, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.

answers.text: A fire fell from the sky
A heavy rain washed the valley
Nothing at all happened at first

questions.text: After sinews, flesh and skin had come on them, what was still lacking?
questions.explanation: There were sinews on them, flesh came up and skin covered them, but there was no breath in them.

questions.text: What did the bodies become once the breath came into them?
questions.explanation: The breath came into them, they lived and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

questions.text: Who do these bones represent, according to the explanation given to the son of man?
questions.explanation: He is told that these bones are the whole house of Israel, who say that their bones are dried up and their hope is lost.

questions.text: What is the son of man told to write on the first stick?
questions.explanation: He is to take one stick and write on it, "For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions."

answers.text: For Joseph and the stick of Ephraim
For Levi and the priests of the house
For Judah and the children of Israel his companions
For Benjamin and the city of the king

questions.text: Who does Yahweh say will be king over them, with one shepherd for them all?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that his servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd.

answers.text: A king out of the nations

questions.text: What kind of covenant will Yahweh make with them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will make a covenant of peace with them, an everlasting covenant, and will set his sanctuary among them forever more.

answers.text: A covenant sealed with the sword
